Hyper-Connections widen the residual stream but break the identity mapping a residual guarantees, which destabilises deep stacks; constraining the residual mixing matrices to be doubly stochastic via Sinkhorn-Knopp restores it while keeping the width, at 6–7% overhead at 3B, 9B and 27B — the residual DeepSeek-V4 ships. | Active |

The doubly-stochastic constraint mHC puts on the residual-mixing matrix bounds it from above but not below, so the mixing can only shrink what distinguishes the streams and the widened residual homogenises with depth; constraining the matrix to the rotation group instead bounds it on both sides, and at four streams a pair of unit quaternions gives it in closed form for no extra parameters. | Active |
